title: Mobile Apps with Appium — pytest Project Companion
title_es: Apps Móviles con Appium — Companion de Proyecto pytest
description: Minimal runnable Appium + pytest project matching the guide: UiAutomator2 conftest, three selector-strategy tests (accessibility id, resource-id, XPath), and a GitHub Actions emulator job — skips cleanly until an APK path is set.
description_es: Proyecto mínimo ejecutable Appium + pytest según la guía: conftest UiAutomator2, tres tests de estrategias de selectores (accessibility id, resource-id, XPath) y un job de GitHub Actions con emulador — salta limpio hasta setear el APK.
run: appium --port 4723 & pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest tests/ -v
requirements: Python 3.10+, Appium server 2.x, Android emulator + APK under test
